blocks.corrected_text: 1.27 In a certain region of space, electric field is along the z-direction throughout. The magnitude of electric field is, however, not constant but increases uniformly along the positive z-direction, at the rate of 10⁵ NC⁻¹ per metre. What are the force and torque experienced by a system having a total dipole moment equal to 10⁻⁷ Cm in the negative z-direction ?

1.29 A hollow charged conductor has a tiny hole cut into its surface. Show that the electric field in the hole is (σ/2ε₀) n̂ , where n̂ is the unit vector in the outward normal direction, and σ is the surface charge density near the hole.

note: n2 had two flattened powers of ten restored (10⁵, 10⁻⁷). n5 had flattened ε0 and a detached hat restored (ε₀, n̂, twice). n3, n6 and n7 already matched the image; n6's 'charge density E' is printed that way on the page itself (not a transcription flattening), so it was left untouched per the notation-only scope of this step.
